content:
alex: Quick check — hit a few SDK vs REST mismatches impacting /generate behavior. SDK (py/ts) omits some fields while our REST clients send explicit defaults, and server defaults are inverted in one handler. Can we sync?

mira: Can you paste minimal request bodies and SDK versions?

alex: Sure, reproducer: 
```json
// REST client payload (JS fetch)
{
  \"model\": \"r-instruct-1\",
  \"input\": \"hello\",
  \"stream\": false
}
```
and the py-sdk ends up sending: 
```json
{
  \"model\": \"r-instruct-1\",
  \"input\": \"hello\"
}
```
Server treats missing `stream` as true and we got streaming responses unexpectedly. SDK version: py-sdk 0.6.3, ts-sdk 0.7.1.

sam: That rings a bell — I think the gateway handler uses `body.get('stream', True)` in one branch so missing -> True. Historically default should be false unless client opts into streaming.

jen: We landed a change in June to try to make legacy clients continue streaming in some rollout, but that shouldn't flip the default globally. Might be a merge regression.

luis: Confirmed in code: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/handlers/generate.py line ~120: `stream = body.get('stream', True)` — that is wrong. I can open a PR to change default to False and add a unit test.

alex: Another discrepancy: param naming — SDKs send `temperature` but some REST clients use `temp`. Backend aliasing only runs in the TS path, so `temp` is ignored in Python flows and falls back to default 1.0. Example: REST -> `{\"temp\": 0.0}` gets ignored by py-handler.

mira: Oof. We intended to accept both `temp` and `temperature` for backwards compat. Alias/normalization should be at the gateway boundary, not in language-specific adapters.

sam: Proposed immediate fixes:
- Fix handler default for boolean flags (stream) to False.
- Add a gateway normalization layer: alias map {"temp":"temperature", "n": "n_predict"} applied before schema validation.
- SDKs should avoid sending explicit nulls for optional lists (stop). Py-sdk currently serializes None -> null; server treats null as [\"\"] in some code paths. SDK should omit keys when value is None.

jen: Agree. Also add contract tests to eng-ci that exercise combinations: missing vs explicit false vs explicit true; temp vs temperature; stop omitted vs [] vs null. That'll catch regressions.

deploy-bot: CI: api-contract-tests failed on PR #1284 — param-mapping-suite (see logs). :warning:

luis: I'll submit a PR with handler fix + gateway alias normalization + tests. Drafting now, ETA EOD. PR link when up.

alex: One more ask — devex: please add a small note in SDK migration guide about omit vs null semantics (py/ts examples). We should discourage sending `null` for optional lists.

mira: Opening tracker issue in SDK repo: https://git.internal/sdks/issues/432 — title: "Do not serialize None -> null for optional list params; omit key instead"

sam: I'll add the eng-ci schema test and a quick linter rule for the TS SDK serializer to prefer undefined over null for optional arrays.

jen: I'll update the API reference doc paragraph on parameter canonicalization and include examples for both SDKs.

luis: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pull/1320 — handler default + aliasing + tests. Requesting reviews from @alex @mira @sam.

alex: Reviewing now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
